<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (twice), 128.30 (twice), 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40 ppm. The duplicated chemical shifts correspond to equivalent carbons, so the number of distinct carbon environments is the count of unique shifts: 7.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
